rv.q: Kazemi's careful pacing continues throughout the play, amplifying Toossi's eloquent, emotionally intelligent writing.

It's a tour de force of writing, direction, and performance; forced into silence by the moment, two characters are left alone with their thoughts — thoughts which play out on their faces, revealing the turmoil roiling their insides.
WISH YOU WERE HERE has layered and compelling storytelling.
It is these revelations that make Wish You Were Here such a compelling look at the pervasive impact of political strife on a community.
Azar Kazemi's excellent production of Sanaz Toossi's WISH YOU WERE HERE provides a thrilling and thought-provoking evening of theatre, laced with a lot of adult humor.
The story is strong! The performances are even stronger!
If you're interested in plays that expand your worldview and are about human connection, Wish You Were Here would be a good fit for you.
